1. (Currently Amended) A proofed frozen dough comprising: (a) a dough mixture of flour, water, and optionally additives, the dough mixture defining a dough matrix; (b) gas bubbles dispersed throughout the dough matrix; (c) a spent yeast component comprising unencapsulated yeast; and (d) a preserved yeast component comprising encapsulated yeast.

2. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 1 to about 8 wt.% of the spent yeast component.

7. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 0.1 to about 2 wt.% of the preserved yeast component.

8. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the preserved yeast component comprises encapsulated yeast, fat-coated yeast, non-hydrated active dry yeast, non-hydrated instant yeast, non-hydrated semi-dry yeast, non-hydrated frozen yeast, or a combination thereof.

11. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the gas bubbles comprise gas produced by the spent yeast component during proofing. 

13. (Currently Amended) A method for making a frozen dough product, the method comprising: (a) mixing dough ingredients to produce a dough composition, the dough ingredients comprising: i. water; ii. flour; iii. a first yeast component comprising unencapsulated yeast; and iv. a second yeast component comprising encapsulated yeast; (b) proofing the dough, wherein during proofing the first yeast is spent and the second yeast is preserved; and (c) freezing the dough after proofing.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second yeast comprises encapsulated yeast, fat coated yeast, non-hydrated active dry yeast, non-hydrated instant yeast, non-hydrated semi-dry yeast, non-hydrated frozen yeast, or a combination thereof.
